documents.title: Null Safety and Uncertain Input
documents.text: null safety and uncertain input scout purpose real programs receive incomplete or invalid information so absence must be modelled instead of ignored. realworlduse android data can be missing from user input saved state databases network responses intents and platform apis. outcome represent optional values explicitly and handle them with checks safe calls elvis defaults and safe parsing. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id absence in the type title make absence visible in the type blocks type paragraph text kotlin distinguishes a non null type such as string from a nullable type such as string . a non null variable must refer to a string a nullable variable may also contain null. this moves many absence errors from runtime into compiler feedback. null should mean that a value is absent or not yet known. it should not be used interchangeably with an empty string zero or false because each of those values may have a legitimate domain meaning. type table title different states are different facts columns value possible meaning rows null no value is available a present but empty string 0 a known numeric value of zero false a known negative boolean answer type paragraph text after checking a stable nullable value against null kotlin can smart cast it inside the safe branch. the compiler permits normal string operations there because the condition proved the value is present. this reasoning works only when the compiler can guarantee the value cannot change between the check and its use. id safe call and elvis title transform or replace an absent value blocks type paragraph text the safe call operator . accesses a property or calls a function only when the receiver is non null otherwise the complete expression returns null. the elvis operator supplies an alternative when the expression on its left is null. together they can express a short safe transformation. use a default only when it preserves the domain meaning. silently replacing an absent price with zero may hide corrupted data while displaying unknown for an optional label may be appropriate. type code language kotlin code val rawcategory string travel nval category rawcategory .trim .takeif it.isnotempty nval displayname category uncategorised n nprintln displayname caption safe calls transform only a present value elvis supplies an explicit presentation fallback. type flow title handle a nullable value steps id receive label receive detail start with a value whose type permits null. id check label check or transform detail use an explicit branch or safe call. id decide label decide absence policy detail keep null return early report error or use a valid default. id continue label continue safely detail use a non null result where required. type callout tone warning title avoid casual double bang text the operator asserts that a value is non null and throws if the assertion is wrong. it removes compiler protection rather than solving absence. id safe parsing title treat external text as untrusted input blocks type paragraph text user input begins as text even when the screen asks for a number. calling todouble on invalid text throws an exception. the todoubleornull function returns a nullable double instead allowing the program to choose a clear validation path. parsing and domain validation are separate abc cannot be parsed while 5 parses successfully but may still violate the rule that an expense must be positive. type code language kotlin code fun parsepositiveamount text string double n val amount text.trim .todoubleornull n return if amount null amount 0.0 amount else null n n nfun main n val amount parsepositiveamount 12.50 n val message if amount null enter a positive number else accepted amount n println message n caption parsing failure and domain rejection both become an explicit nullable result for this small program. type paragraph text in larger applications a single null may not explain why validation failed. later lessons will introduce sealed result models that preserve specific error reasons. the first principle remains translate uncertain external data at the boundary then let the rest of the program work with stronger types and explicit outcomes. furtherreading title null safety publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs null safety.html whyread the complete official guide to nullable types smart casts safe calls elvis expressions and risky assertions. title strings conversion publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs strings.html#string conversion whyread shows parsing apis and their ornull alternatives for handling uncertain external text without avoidable exceptions. inspect title validate a possible amount language kotlin code fun amountmessage raw string string n val amount raw .trim .todoubleornull n return when n amount null enter a number n amount 0.0 amount must be positive n else accepted amount n n n nfun main n println amountmessage 18.75 n println amountmessage free n walkthrough the parameter type admits that no text may be supplied. a safe call chain stops with null if the input is absent or cannot be parsed. when distinguishes missing or invalid numeric text from a parsed non positive value. expectedoutput accepted 18.75 nenter a number trap check mistake using merely to silence a nullable type compiler error. why the assertion can move a detectable absence into a runtime nullpointerexception. fix choose an explicit absence policy with a check safe call elvis value or early return. mistake treating a parsed number as automatically valid domain data. why parsing proves only that the text has numeric form not that the value satisfies business rules. fix validate range and domain rules after parsing. challenge intro task write a function that accepts nullable amount text and returns either a usable positive value or a clear validation message. successlookslike invalid input never throws absence is handled deliberately and the valid path works with a non null number. recall id level 01 week 01 06 null safety recall 1 prompt what does the question mark in string mean answer the type permits either a string value or null. id level 01 week 01 06 null safety recall 2 prompt what does a safe call do when its receiver is null answer it skips the access or call and returns null for the expression. id level 01 week 01 06 null safety recall 3 prompt why use todoubleornull for external text answer it represents invalid numeric text as null instead of throwing an exception. kotlin null safety input validation

documents.title: Designing a Small Program
documents.text: designing a small program scout purpose knowing syntax is not enough developers must turn a vague request into small verifiable program responsibilities. realworlduse every android feature begins as requirements that must be translated into inputs rules state changes outputs and failure behaviour. outcome decompose and trace a small expense program then diagnose errors using evidence. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id requirements to data title translate prose into program facts blocks type paragraph text begin with one observable requirement accept an expense amount and category reject invalid data and print an approved summary. underline the nouns to find data and the verbs to find behaviour. amount and category become inputs. accept reject and print become decisions or actions. write examples before code a positive amount and non blank category should succeed invalid numeric text zero negative amounts and blank categories should fail. examples make vague words such as valid concrete. type flow title from requirement to program steps id requirement label requirement detail state one observable user outcome. id examples label examples detail list successful and failing cases. id data label data detail choose names and types for required information. id rules label rules detail express validation and calculation decisions. id output label output detail present one result at the boundary. id verify label verify detail run examples and compare actual results. type paragraph text do not begin by creating many abstractions. a small program can use a few functions and basic types. extract a function when it names a business rule removes meaningful duplication or lets you reason about one responsibility in isolation. keep input and output near the program boundary so inner calculations are deterministic the same arguments should produce the same result. id pipeline title build a validation and transformation pipeline blocks type paragraph text a useful processing pipeline receives raw information normalises it parses it validates domain rules calculates derived values and presents a result. each stage should strengthen what is known. after parsing the program has a number instead of arbitrary text. after validation it has an amount permitted by the business rule. when a stage fails stop or return an explicit failure rather than allowing invalid data to travel deeper. type code language kotlin code fun parseamount raw string double raw.trim .todoubleornull n nfun isvalidexpense amount double category string boolean n amount 0.0 category.isnotblank n nfun summary amount double category string string n category amount caption three small functions separate boundary parsing domain validation and presentation. type table title pipeline responsibility columns stage question rows normalise can harmless formatting be removed parse can raw text become the required type validate does the typed value satisfy domain rules transform what result must be calculated present how should the outcome be communicated id debug with evidence title debug the first broken assumption blocks type paragraph text debugging is the process of finding where actual behaviour first diverges from expected behaviour. reproduce the problem with the smallest known input. read the first compiler error or capture the exact output. trace values at function boundaries. change one thing and rerun the same example. if the program compiles but gives the wrong result inspect assumptions about type operator order branch order loop boundaries and state updates before rewriting the whole solution. type code language kotlin code fun main n val rawamount 12.50 n val category food n val amount parseamount rawamount n n val message when n amount null amount is not a number n isvalidexpense amount category expense is invalid n else summary amount category n n n println message n caption main coordinates the pipeline and handles failure before calling functions that require a valid amount. type paragraph text a trace is temporary evidence not the final design. printing intermediate values can help in this console program later android work will use breakpoints structured logs tests and profilers. after fixing the cause remove noisy diagnostics and record the enduring rule as a clear name validation branch or automated test. the goal is not merely to make one example pass but to improve the program s explanation of its own behaviour. furtherreading title kotlin coding conventions publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs coding conventions.html whyread connects small program design to readable naming formatting immutability preferences and idiomatic kotlin structure. title introduction to programming in kotlin publisher android developers resourcetype guide url https developer.android.com courses pathways android basics compose unit 1 pathway 1 whyread collects the official first program variables functions practice and checkpoint material into one reinforcement pathway. title basic syntax overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs basic syntax.html whyread a compact reference to revisit while assembling the week 1 concepts into one complete console program. inspect title trace the complete expense path language kotlin code fun parseamount raw string double raw.trim .todoubleornull nfun isvalidexpense amount double category string amount 0.0 category.isnotblank nfun summary amount double category string category amount n nfun main n val rawamount 9.75 n val category travel n val amount parseamount rawamount n n if amount null n println enter a number n else if isvalidexpense amount category n println invalid expense n else n println summary amount category n n walkthrough raw text is converted at the boundary and represented as nullable when conversion may fail. the null branch returns a user facing failure path before validation receives a double. valid typed data flows through the business rule and then into presentation. expectedoutput travel 9.75 trap check mistake writing code before defining successful and failing examples. why words such as valid or correct remain ambiguous so the implementation has no precise target. fix list observable input output examples before choosing functions. mistake changing several functions while debugging one failing input. why multiple edits destroy the evidence needed to identify which assumption was wrong. fix reproduce trace the first divergence and make one focused change. challenge intro task complete the week 1 expense entry program with parsing validation summary output and at least five manually traced examples. successlookslike valid input succeeds invalid input never throws functions have focused contracts and the trace identifies each pipeline stage. recall id level 01 week 01 07 small program design recall 1 prompt how do nouns and verbs help decompose a requirement answer nouns suggest data verbs suggest decisions transformations or actions. id level 01 week 01 07 small program design recall 2 prompt what should each pipeline stage accomplish answer it should strengthen what the program knows or return an explicit failure. id level 01 week 01 07 small program design recall 3 prompt where should debugging begin answer at the first point where actual behaviour differs from a reproducible expectation. kotlin problem solving debugging expense manager

documents.title: Classes, Objects, Interfaces, and Composition
documents.text: classes objects interfaces and composition scout purpose classes let a program place related state and behaviour behind a meaningful type instead of passing unrelated values everywhere. realworlduse android code uses classes for screen state holders repositories data sources workers services and adapters to platform apis. outcome design a small class with protected invariants an interface contract and collaboration through composition. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id objects and constructors title objects combine state and behaviour blocks type paragraph text a class describes a family of objects. its constructor receives the information required to create a valid instance properties retain relevant state and member functions expose behaviour. put a rule inside the type when every caller must obey it. an expense class should not require each screen or report to remember independently that an amount must be positive. keep constructor inputs small and meaningful an object that needs unrelated services flags and data often has more than one responsibility. type code language kotlin code class expense n val category string n val amount double n n init n require category.isnotblank n require amount 0.0 n n n fun summary string category amount n caption the constructor captures required state init protects invariants and summary exposes behaviour on valid objects. type callout tone remember title valid from construction text prefer preventing invalid objects at creation over allowing them and asking every later operation to check again. id interfaces and substitution title interfaces describe capabilities blocks type paragraph text an interface defines a contract without choosing one concrete implementation. callers depend on the capability they need such as expensestore.save rather than a specific file or database. an implementing class promises to honour the contract. interfaces are valuable at real variation boundaries external systems and test seams. creating an interface for every class adds names without adding flexibility so begin with concrete code and extract the boundary when there is a clear reason. type code language kotlin code interface expensestore n fun save expense expense n n nclass inmemoryexpensestore expensestore n private val items mutablelistof expense n n override fun save expense expense n items + expense n n caption the store contract hides where expenses are retained while the in memory implementation owns its mutable list. type table title choose the construct columns need construct rows create valid state with behaviour class represent one shared instance object declaration describe a replaceable capability interface add a specialised is a relationship inheritance used deliberately id composition title compose collaborators instead of building deep hierarchies blocks type paragraph text composition gives an object another object that performs a required role. expenseservice can receive an expensestore and coordinate validation or saving without inheriting store behaviour. this keeps the relationship explicit and replaceable. inheritance is appropriate when the subtype truly satisfies the parent contract and callers can use either safely. it is not a general code reuse tool. android framework types sometimes require inheritance but application level behaviour usually remains easier to change when assembled from focused collaborators. type code language kotlin code class expenseservice n private val store expensestore n n fun record category string amount double expense n val expense expense category amount n store.save expense n return expense n n caption expenseservice delegates storage through an injected capability and owns only the record workflow. type flow title a composed request steps id caller label caller detail supplies raw record information. id service label service detail coordinates the use case. id model label model detail protects expense invariants. id store label store detail persists through its contract. id result label result detail returns the valid recorded expense. type paragraph text composition also makes testing more direct pass a small fake collaborator invoke the use case and inspect the recorded interaction without constructing a framework hierarchy. furtherreading title classes publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs classes.html whyread the official guide to constructors properties initialisation members inheritance and class design syntax. title interfaces publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs interfaces.html whyread explains interface declarations implementations default members and resolving inherited contract conflicts. inspect title trace a composed recording flow language kotlin code interface expensestore fun save expense expense nclass consolestore expensestore n override fun save expense expense println saved expense.category n ndata class expense val category string val amount double nclass recorder private val store expensestore n fun record category string amount double n require amount 0.0 n store.save expense category amount n n nfun main recorder consolestore .record food 8.5 walkthrough consolestore fulfils the expensestore capability. recorder receives the abstraction through its constructor instead of creating storage internally. the valid request becomes an expense and is delegated to the supplied store. expectedoutput saved food trap check mistake adding inheritance only to reuse a helper function. why the subtype relationship becomes misleading and couples unrelated responsibilities. fix extract a collaborator or extension when there is no genuine is a contract. mistake leaving required properties mutable and publicly writable. why any caller can break the object invariant after construction. fix prefer val and expose focused methods for legitimate state changes. challenge intro task build expense expensestore inmemoryexpensestore and expenserecorder so invalid expenses cannot be created and storage can be replaced. successlookslike expense construction rejects blank categories and non positive amounts. recorder depends on expensestore rather than a concrete list. the in memory implementation does not expose its mutable collection. recall id level 01 week 02 01 classes objects composition recall 1 prompt what should a constructor guarantee answer it should gather required inputs and create an object whose invariants hold. id level 01 week 02 01 classes objects composition recall 2 prompt when does an interface earn its place answer at a meaningful capability variation boundary external dependency or test seam. id level 01 week 02 01 classes objects composition recall 3 prompt what does composition make explicit answer which focused collaborators an object uses to perform its responsibility. kotlin classes interfaces composition

documents.title: Data Classes, Enums, and Sealed Models
documents.text: data classes enums and sealed models scout purpose kotlin provides specialised types for value records fixed labels and closed alternatives choosing the right one makes invalid states harder to express. realworlduse compose ui state repository results navigation destinations and user actions frequently use immutable data classes and sealed hierarchies. outcome choose data enum and sealed types based on identity and alternatives then handle closed states exhaustively. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id data values title data classes model values blocks type paragraph text a data class is suited to records whose meaning comes primarily from their property values. the compiler provides value based equals hashcode tostring component functions and copy. prefer val properties so a state transition creates a new value instead of mutating shared state. copy is shallow nested mutable objects are still shared unless they are also replaced or designed immutably. data classes do not validate automatically constructor and factory rules still matter. type code language kotlin code data class expensedraft n val category string n val amounttext string n val note string n n nval initial expensedraft nval edited initial.copy category travel caption copy expresses one immutable state change while preserving the untouched properties. type table title value or identity columns question likely model rows are two instances equal when their fields match data class does one long lived object own changing behaviour regular class is there exactly one named instance object declaration is this a fixed named option enum entry id enum fixed options title enums represent fixed named constants blocks type paragraph text use an enum when each alternative is a singleton of the same simple concept such as an expense category or sort direction. enum entries may have properties and functions but large amounts of entry specific behaviour can become difficult to scan. persisting enum ordinal values is fragile because reordering entries changes their numbers. prefer a stable explicit code when an enum crosses storage or network boundaries and define how unknown future values are handled. type code language kotlin code enum class expensecategory val storagecode string n food food n travel travel n equipment equipment n n nfun expensecategory.displayname string n name.lowercase .replacefirstchar char uppercase caption a stable storage code is separate from declaration order and presentation text. type callout tone warning title boundary stability text names ordinals and display labels can change. persist an intentional stable representation and parse unknown input safely. id sealed alternatives title sealed types model closed alternatives with different data blocks type paragraph text a sealed class or interface limits direct alternatives to a known set letting when check exhaustiveness. unlike enum entries each alternative can carry different data. a load result may be loading success with expenses or failure with an explanation. the closed hierarchy documents every state the consumer must consider. do not use a sealed type for an ecosystem intended to accept third party implementations the restriction is valuable only when the set should be controlled. type code language kotlin code sealed interface saveresult n data class saved val expense expense saveresult n data class rejected val reason string saveresult n n nfun message result saveresult string when result n is saveresult.saved saved result.expense.category n is saveresult.rejected result.reason n caption every result carries appropriate data and when covers the complete closed set without else. type flow title model selection steps id same fields label value record detail use a data class when properties define equality. id fixed label fixed constants detail use an enum for simple singleton options. id different label different payloads detail use a sealed hierarchy for closed alternatives. id open label open extension detail use an interface when external implementations are valid. furtherreading title data classes publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs data classes.html whyread covers generated members copy behaviour destructuring and the constraints placed on data class constructors. title sealed classes and interfaces publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs sealed classes.html whyread explains controlled hierarchies exhaustive when expressions inheritance restrictions and practical state modelling. title enum classes publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs enum classes.html whyread provides the official reference for enum entries properties functions iteration and interface implementation. inspect title render a closed save result language kotlin code data class expense val category string val amount double nsealed interface saveresult n data class saved val value expense saveresult n data class rejected val problems list string saveresult n nfun describe result saveresult when result n is saveresult.saved saved result.value.amount n is saveresult.rejected result.problems.jointostring n nfun main println describe saveresult.rejected listof amount required walkthrough expense is a value record with generated equality. each saveresult alternative carries data suited to that outcome. when is exhaustive because every direct sealed alternative is handled. expectedoutput amount required trap check mistake using a data class with publicly mutable nested collections. why copy can share the same mutable collection so changes leak between supposedly independent values. fix expose read only immutable data or replace nested values during a transition. mistake persisting an enum ordinal as permanent data. why reordering or inserting entries changes ordinals and corrupts meaning. fix persist a stable explicit code and parse it deliberately. challenge intro task create an immutable draft a category enum with stable codes and a sealed validation result that lists every failure or carries a valid expense. successlookslike draft updates use copy rather than public mutation. category persistence does not depend on enum ordinal. validation result handling is exhaustive without a catch all else. recall id level 01 week 02 02 data enum sealed models recall 1 prompt what does data class copy not guarantee answer it does not deep copy nested mutable objects. id level 01 week 02 02 data enum sealed models recall 2 prompt when is an enum preferable to a sealed type answer when alternatives are simple fixed singleton constants with the same shape. id level 01 week 02 02 data enum sealed models recall 3 prompt why can when omit else for a sealed hierarchy answer the compiler knows the controlled set of direct alternatives and can verify documents.title: Collections and Transformation Pipelines
documents.text: collections and transformation pipelines scout purpose collections let one operation describe how a group of values should be selected transformed grouped or summarised. realworlduse android applications transform database rows network models ui lists settings search results and analytics events through collection operations. outcome choose list set or map control mutability and build readable eager transformation pipelines. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id collection shapes title choose the shape from the question blocks type paragraph text a list preserves order and permits duplicates. a set represents membership with unique elements. a map associates unique keys with values. choose based on the domain question not convenience transaction history is ordered selected tag ids are unique and expenses by id form a lookup. kotlin separates read only interfaces from mutable interfaces. a val holding mutablelist cannot be reassigned but the list can still change. expose the narrowest read only view that callers need and keep mutation close to its owner. type table title collection choice columns question type rows does order and repetition matter list t is membership unique set t do unique keys locate values map k v must this owner add or remove a mutable variant kept private type code language kotlin code class expensebook n private val entries mutablelistof expense n val expenses list expense get entries.tolist n n fun add expense expense entries + expense n caption mutation stays private and callers receive a snapshot that they cannot modify through this api. id operators title transform without changing the source blocks type paragraph text operations such as filter map sortedby distinctby groupby associateby and fold return results derived from the receiver. name intermediate results when a long chain mixes several ideas. filter keeps elements satisfying a predicate map changes each element groupby builds lists under a key associateby expects one value per key and later duplicates overwrite earlier ones. select the operation whose output shape matches the next step. type code language kotlin code val traveltotalsbyday expenses n .filter it.category expensecategory.travel n .groupby it.day n .mapvalues daily daily.sumof expense amount n .tosortedmap caption the pipeline selects travel items groups them reduces each group then orders the keyed result. type flow title read a collection chain steps id source label source detail identify element type and mutability. id select label select detail filter only values that qualify. id shape label transform detail map group or associate into a new shape. id reduce label reduce detail summarise when one result is required. id consume label consume detail present or return the final type. id eager costs title understand allocation and failure choices blocks type paragraph text standard collection chains are eager each intermediate operator commonly creates a new collection. for ordinary screen sized data this clarity is often the right tradeoff. for large pipelines sequence may avoid intermediate collections but adds its own overhead and should be measured. functions such as first and single throw when their assumptions fail while firstornull and singleornull represent uncertainty. use throwing variants only when absence proves an internal invariant is broken not when empty data is expected. type code language kotlin code fun largestexpense expenses list expense expense n expenses.maxbyornull expense amount n nfun totalbycategory expenses list expense map expensecategory double n expenses.groupby expense category n .mapvalues values values.sumof expense amount caption nullable and keyed results communicate the possible empty input and output shape. type callout tone remember title clarity before cleverness text prefer a readable eager pipeline first. change representation only after data size and measurement reveal a real problem. type paragraph text when two operations produce the same result prefer the one whose name communicates the domain step and whose intermediate values remain easy to inspect during debugging. furtherreading title collections overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs collections overview.html whyread introduces list set map read only and mutable interfaces hierarchy equality and variance. title collection operations overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs collection operations.html whyread maps the standard selection transformation grouping ordering aggregation and retrieval operations. inspect title trace a grouped total language kotlin code data class expense val category string val amount double nfun main n val expenses listof n expense food 5.0 n expense travel 8.0 n expense food 3.0 n n val totals expenses.groupby it.category n .mapvalues items items.sumof it.amount n println totals n walkthrough groupby produces a map string list expense . mapvalues keeps each key and transforms its list into a double total. linked insertion order makes the printed keys follow their first appearance in this example. expectedoutput food 8.0 travel 8.0 trap check mistake returning a private mutablelist through a list typed property without copying. why the underlying object may still be mutated through another retained mutable reference. fix return an immutable snapshot or use an immutable collection implementation. mistake calling documents.title: Git, Pull Requests, and Useful Documentation
documents.text: git pull requests and useful documentation scout purpose version control creates a reviewable history of intent while documentation and pull requests let a team understand why a change exists and whether it is safe to integrate. realworlduse android applications combine source gradle configuration resources schemas and tests git coordinates changes across all of them and ci checks proposed integrations. outcome create focused commits reason about branches and merges prepare a reviewable pull request and write documentation that answers future maintainers real questions. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id snapshots title git records connected snapshots blocks type paragraph text a repository stores project history. the working tree is what you currently see the staging area selects the exact changes intended for the next commit and a commit records a snapshot with metadata and parent links. git content is not automatically saved merely because a file changed. inspect status and the staged diff before committing so unrelated work is not captured. a strong commit represents one coherent reason keeps the project usable where practical and has a message that explains the outcome rather than narrating keystrokes. history becomes an engineering tool when another person can revert compare or diagnose it. type code language shell code git status ngit diff ngit add content lessons new lesson.json ngit diff staged ngit commit m add week 4 terminal lesson caption the working diff is inspected one intended file is staged and the exact staged snapshot is reviewed before commit. type table title git states columns state question rows working tree what differs from the checked out commit staging area what exactly will the next commit contain commit what durable snapshot and intent are recorded branch which movable name points to the current line of work id branches review title a branch isolates a line of work a pull request hosts review blocks type paragraph text a branch is a movable reference to a commit not a full copy of the project. new commits advance the current branch. merging joins histories and a conflict means git cannot choose a correct combined result from text alone. resolve conflicts by understanding both intents then run the relevant checks. a pull request proposes integrating one branch and provides a durable conversation around the diff. its description should state the problem approach evidence risks and any manual review required. review code for correctness and maintainability and review generated content or assets for semantic quality not merely whether ci is green. type code language shell code git switch c level 1 week 4 ngit log oneline decorate 5 ngit diff main...head caption the branch and risk. id review label review and revise detail address findings and rerun checks. id merge label merge detail integrate after required evidence passes. id documentation title document decisions and operating knowledge blocks type paragraph text good documentation serves a specific reader and task. a readme should explain what the repository is how to validate it and where deeper guidance lives. an authoring guide records repeatable content rules. comments should explain a surprising constraint or decision not translate obvious syntax. a decision record captures context alternatives the chosen direction and consequences when a design choice will matter later. keep commands executable examples current and links stable. documentation is part of the change update it in the same pull request and review it against the actual behaviour. old confident instructions are more dangerous than an honest gap. type code language markdown code ## validate content n n sh nnpm install nnpm run test content n n nthe command validates source json regenerates indexes and checks generated output. caption this documentation names the task gives reproducible commands and explains the expected result. type callout tone remember title write for the next decision text document what a maintainer needs to operate or change the system including constraints and verification not a diary of implementation. furtherreading title pro git git basics publisher git project resourcetype official docs url https git scm.com book en v2 git basics recording changes to the repository whyread whyread introduces audience focused documentation clear sentences lists and useful code examples. inspect title review a focused history language shell code git status ngit diff staged ngit log oneline decorate 3 walkthrough status reveals untracked modified and staged paths. the staged diff is the proposed commit so it deserves review before recording. the concise log shows commit boundaries and the branch pointer. expectedoutput a reviewer should be able to connect each staged change to one stated outcome. trap check mistake using git add . without reviewing unrelated changes. why the commit may capture secrets generated noise or another unfinished task. fix stage exact paths and inspect git diff staged before committing. mistake writing a pull request description that only repeats its title. why reviewers lack context risk assessment and verification evidence. fix describe the problem approach tests risks and manual review needs. challenge intro task create a branch and a documentation only commit that explains how to validate droidquest content then draft a pull request description with purpose evidence and risks. successlookslike the staged diff contains only the documents.title: Debugging with Evidence
documents.text: debugging with evidence scout purpose debugging is the disciplined reduction of uncertainty reproduce a failure gather evidence test a specific explanation and verify the smallest repair. realworlduse android failures surface through compiler diagnostics logcat exceptions stack traces breakpoints inspectors and device specific state. outcome read a stack trace choose useful breakpoints and observations distinguish symptoms from causes and verify a fix with a regression check. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id hypothesis title reproduce before explaining blocks type paragraph text a bug report describes an observed mismatch between expected and actual behaviour. begin by making that mismatch reproducible with precise inputs environment and steps. reduce the failing case until irrelevant variables disappear. then state a falsifiable hypothesis the parser accepts a blank amount because trim occurs after validation is testable the app is broken is not. change one relevant variable or add one focused observation. random edits destroy information because success no longer identifies which assumption was wrong. if reproduction is intermittent record timing device build data and logs instead of pretending the uncertainty does not exist. type code language kotlin code fun parseamount raw string double n require raw.isnotblank amount is blank n return raw.trim .todouble n n nfun main n println parseamount n caption the smallest failing input isolates blank validation from ui persistence and networking concerns. type flow title evidence loop steps id reproduce label reproduce detail capture expected result actual result input and environment. id localise label localise detail reduce the failing path and identify the first wrong state. id hypothesis label hypothesise detail state one explanation that evidence can disprove. id experiment label experiment detail observe or change one relevant condition. id verify label verify detail run the reproduction and broader regression checks. id stack title read a stack trace from the exception outward blocks type paragraph text an exception report names the exception type its message and stack frames describing active calls. in a typical jvm trace the first frame beneath the exception is where that exception was thrown following frames show callers moving outward. start with the first frame belonging to your code then inspect inputs and earlier state. a caused by section records a wrapped underlying exception and may contain the actionable origin. line numbers refer to a particular build so use matching source. the deepest frame is not automatically the root cause invalid data may have been created much earlier and only detected at the throw site. type code language text code exception in thread main java.lang.illegalargumentexception amount is blank n at expenseparser.parseamount expenseparser.kt 8 n at expenseimporter.importline expenseimporter.kt 21 n at mainkt.main main.kt 5 caption read from parseamount where failure was detected outward through importline to the entry point. type table title trace evidence columns part question rows exception type what failure category was reported message what detail did the throwing code provide top relevant frame where was the failure detected in our code caller frames which path supplied this state caused by was another exception wrapped underneath id tools title observe state without changing the question blocks type paragraph text a breakpoint pauses execution before or after a chosen line so a debugger can inspect variables evaluate limited expressions and step through calls. place it near the first wrong state not merely at application startup. step over executes a line without entering called functions step into follows a relevant call and step out completes the current function. logging is better for timing sensitive or remote failures but logs need stable context and must not expose credentials or private user data. after repair encode the original reproduction as a test when possible. a fix is not verified because the exception disappeared once expected behaviour and nearby cases must still hold. type code language kotlin code fun parseamount raw string result double runcatching n val normalised raw.trim inspect raw and normalised here n require normalised.isnotempty amount is blank n normalised.todouble n caption a breakpoint after normalisation reveals whether the state first becomes wrong before validation. type callout tone warning title debugger evaluation can have side effects text avoid calling mutating functions from the debugger an observation that changes state can hide the original failure. furtherreading title debug your app publisher android developers resourcetype official docs url https developer.android.com studio debug whyread covers debuggable builds breakpoints stepping watches variable inspection and android studio debugger controls. title analyze a stack trace publisher android developers resourcetype official docs url https developer.android.com studio debug stacktraces whyread shows how stack traces identify exceptions frames source locations and obfuscated release code. inspect title localise an invalid amount language kotlin code fun average values list double double values.sum values.size nfun main n val values emptylist double n println average values n walkthrough reproduction fixes the relevant input as an empty list. a breakpoint inside average reveals size is zero before division. the domain question is whether empty input should be rejected or represented explicitly not how to hide the printed result. expectedoutput the program prints nan a verified repair must define and test empty list behaviour. trap check mistake editing several suspected lines before reproducing. why any changed behaviour is impossible to attribute and new defects may be introduced. fix create a minimal reproduction and test one hypothesis at a time. mistake stopping when the visible exception disappears. why the symptom may be hidden while invalid state still exists or another case regresses. fix verify expected output and add the original reproduction as a regression test. challenge intro task given a small expense import program and a repeatable exception write a debugging record containing reproduction stack trace interpretation one hypothesis experiment repair and regression checks. successlookslike the first wrong state is distinguished from the final symptom. only one hypothesis is tested in the experiment. verification includes the original failure and at least two nearby cases. recall id level 01 week 04 03 debugging stack traces recall 1 prompt where do you begin reading a jvm stack trace answer at the exception and first relevant application frame then outward through callers and causes. id level 01 week 04 03 debugging stack traces recall 2 prompt what makes a debugging hypothesis useful answer it predicts evidence that can confirm or disprove one explanation. id level 01 week 04 03 debugging stack traces recall 3 prompt why add a regression test answer it proves the original failure is repaired and guards against its return. debugging stack traces breakpoints tooling

documents.title: Data Structures and Practical Complexity
documents.text: data structures and practical complexity scout purpose choosing a representation determines which operations are simple which invariants are visible and how work grows as data becomes larger. realworlduse ui lists caches indexes deduplication navigation stacks queues and database adapters all depend on deliberate collection and algorithm choices. outcome select lists sets maps stacks and queues by required operations then compare constant linear and logarithmic growth without premature optimisation. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id operations title choose for operations and invariants blocks type paragraph text a data structure is an organisation of values together with supported operations. a list preserves order and permits duplicates indexed access is direct while searching for an unknown value generally scans elements. a set represents uniqueness and answers membership efficiently in typical hash based implementations. a map associates unique keys with values and is useful when lookup begins with an identifier. a stack removes the most recently added item while a queue removes the earliest waiting item. the best choice follows the domain invariant and dominant operations not habit. if order matters and duplicates are meaningful a set would destroy information even if membership is fast. type code language kotlin code val ordered listof food travel food nval unique ordered.toset nval byid expenses.associateby it.id n nval found byid expenseid expense 7 caption each transformation changes the contract ordered retains repetition unique removes it and byid enables key based lookup. type table title structure selection columns structure preserves order duplicates typical strength rows list yes yes iteration and indexed sequence set implementation dependent no membership and uniqueness map implementation dependent keys no lookup by key stack deque access order yes last in first out work queue deque access order yes first in first out work id growth title complexity describes growth not stopwatch time blocks type paragraph text time complexity compares how operation counts grow with input size n. constant o 1 work does not grow with n in the model linear o n work grows proportionally logarithmic o log n repeatedly reduces the remaining search space quadratic o n2 often compares many pairs. big o omits hardware constants allocation and small input effects so it predicts scalability rather than exact duration. a hash map lookup is typically constant average time but can degrade with collisions. binary search is logarithmic only when data is sorted and supports efficient indexed access. always state the operation assumptions and data size instead of labelling an entire feature fast. type code language kotlin code fun containsduplicate values list string boolean n val seen mutablesetof string n for value in values n if seen.add value return true n n return false n caption one pass performs typical constant time set insertions giving expected o n time and o n additional space. type flow title growth comparison steps id constant label o 1 detail direct map lookup by known key under typical hashing. id log label o log n detail binary search halves sorted search space. id linear label o n detail scan every expense once. id nlogn label o n log n detail typical comparison sorting. id quadratic label o n2 detail compare every item with many others. id tradeoffs title improve representation before clever loops blocks type paragraph text performance choices trade time memory ordering and implementation complexity. building a map costs linear time and extra space but pays off when many later lookups use the key. for one lookup in a tiny list a scan may be clearer. maintain invariants at the boundary duplicate ids should be rejected when building an index rather than silently overwritten unless replacement is the policy. kotlin collection chains are expressive but repeated filters or nested searches can hide multiple passes. measure representative workloads after choosing the simplest correct structure. optimisation should preserve readability and include a benchmark or test that explains why the complexity is justified. type code language kotlin code fun indexbyid expenses list expense map expenseid expense n require expenses.map it.id .toset .size expenses.size n duplicate expense id n n return expenses.associateby it.id n caption the function makes unique keys an explicit precondition before constructing the fast lookup representation. type callout tone remember title space is part of the cost text a faster lookup structure often stores an additional index. include memory construction update and correctness costs in the decision. contracts along with read only and mutable collection interfaces. title collection operations overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs collection operations.html whyread surveys transformations filtering grouping ordering aggregation and other operations whose passes and allocations should be understood. title algorithms part i publisher princeton university resourcetype guide url https www.coursera.org learn algorithms part1 whyread offers deeper optional study of union find stacks queues sorting searching trees and hash tables. inspect title replace repeated scans with an index language kotlin code data class expense val id string val amount double nfun main n val expenses listof expense a 3.0 expense b 5.0 n val byid expenses.associateby it.id n println byid b .amount n walkthrough associateby scans the list once to construct a map. the resulting key lookup is typically constant average time. duplicate ids would overwrite earlier values so production code must decide and enforce that policy. expectedoutput 5.0 trap check mistake choosing a set when duplicate order carries meaning. why the representation silently discards information required by the domain. fix write the invariants first then select the structure that preserves them. mistake calling an algorithm o 1 because it was fast in one test. why elapsed time at one size does not describe how work grows. fix count dominant operations state assumptions and measure representative sizes. challenge intro task implement an expense collection that preserves display order rejects duplicate ids supports typical constant time lookup by id and documents the complexity of each public operation. successlookslike display order remains deterministic. duplicate identifiers produce an explicit failure. complexity claims name average or worst case assumptions. recall id level 01 week 04 04 data structures complexity recall 1 prompt documents.text: http rest and json boundaries scout purpose mobile applications exchange messages with remote systems and correctness depends on understanding the protocol and treating external data as untrusted. realworlduse retrofit okhttp web apis authentication caching retries and offline synchronisation all build on http requests responses and serialised payloads. outcome describe an http exchange choose methods and interpret status families distinguish resource design from transport and validate json into domain models. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id exchange title http is a request response protocol blocks type paragraph text an http client sends a request containing a method target uri headers and sometimes a body. a server returns a status code headers and sometimes a body. the method expresses intended semantics get retrieves a representation post commonly submits or creates put replaces at a known target patch applies a partial modification and delete requests removal. safe methods should not request state change idempotent methods can be repeated with the same intended effect though logging and timestamps may still differ. https protects the connection in transit but does not make response data truthful or application logic authorised. type code language http code get v1 expenses month 2026 07 http 1.1 nhost api.example.test naccept application json n nhttp 1.1 200 ok ncontent type application json n n items id e7 amount 12.5 caption the request target includes a path and query headers negotiate json the response status and media type describe the returned representation. type flow title http exchange steps id build label build request detail choose method uri headers and optional body. id send label send detail transport bytes over a connection normally protected by tls. id handle label handle response detail interpret status headers and body together. id map label map result detail validate transport data into an application outcome. id semantics title status and rest conventions shape behaviour blocks type paragraph text status codes are grouped by first digit 2xx reports successful handling 3xx redirects 4xx reports a request side problem and 5xx reports a server side failure. the exact code matters 201 can include the location of a created resource 204 has no response body 401 concerns authentication 403 authorisation 404 absence and 429 rate limiting. a rest style api models addressable resources and uses http semantics consistently but rest is an architectural style rather than a synonym for json. retry policy depends on method idempotency failure stage server guidance and business operation blindly retrying a payment like post can duplicate side effects. type code language kotlin code when response.code n in 200..299 decodesuccess response n 401 apiresult.authenticationrequired n 404 apiresult.notfound n 429 apiresult.retrylater response.retryafter n in 500..599 apiresult.serverfailure response.code n else apiresult.unexpected response.code n caption transport outcomes become explicit application results rather than one undifferentiated exception. type table title status families columns family meaning client question rows 2xx request handled successfully is a body expected for this exact code 3xx further redirection action should the client follow or cache it 4xx request cannot be fulfilled as sent must identity input or rate handling change 5xx server failed to fulfil a valid request is a bounded retry safe and useful id json boundary title json is syntax not a trusted domain model blocks type paragraph text json represents objects arrays strings numbers booleans and null. it does not carry kotlin types dates decimal money semantics sealed variants or validation rules. a transport data transfer object should mirror the remote contract including optional or unknown fields. mapping then validates required values parses units and dates rejects impossible states and produces a domain model. keep transport concerns such as snake case names and nullable legacy fields out of core business types. parsers should tolerate explicitly supported evolution while failing visibly on corrupt required data. log enough context to diagnose a mapping failure but never log credentials or sensitive payloads. type code language kotlin code serializable ndata class expensedto val id string val amountminor long n nfun expensedto.todomain expense n val safeid id .takeif it.isnotblank error missing id n val minor requirenotnull amountminor missing amount n require minor 0 negative amount n return expense expenseid safeid money minor n caption the dto accepts transport uncertainty the mapper creates a validated domain value or an explicit failure. type callout tone warning title do not use double for exact currency text json numbers have no currency semantics. prefer an agreed integer minor unit or decimal representation and validate its range. furtherreading title overview of http publisher mdn web docs resourcetype guide url https developer.mozilla.org en us docs web http guides overview whyread explains clients servers requests responses intermediaries connections and the stateless protocol model. title http request methods publisher mdn web docs resourcetype guide url https developer.mozilla.org en us docs web http reference methods whyread summarises method semantics including safety idempotency and cacheability. title kotlin serialization publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs serialization.html whyread introduces typed serialisation setup json encoding and decoding and custom serialisers in kotlin. inspect title map transport data safely language kotlin code data class expensedto val id string val amountminor long ndata class expense val id string val amountminor long nfun expensedto.todomainornull expense n val safeid id .trim .takeif it.isnotempty return null n val safeamount amountminor .takeif it 0 return null n return expense safeid safeamount n walkthrough the dto mirrors uncertain external values. validation and normalisation happen at one mapping boundary. the domain expense is created only when both invariants hold. expectedoutput expensedto e7 1250 maps to expense e7 1250 invalid input maps to null. trap check mistake retrying every failed post automatically. why the first attempt may have succeeded remotely so another request can duplicate a side effect. fix use idempotency keys or operation specific reconciliation and retry policy. mistake deserialising external json directly into a permissive domain model. why transport nullability and naming leak inward and invalid states survive longer. fix use a dto and explicit validation mapper at the boundary. challenge intro task design request dto domain and result types for loading expenses including status handling and validation for missing ids and negative amounts. text into typed use cases and a console adapter prints results. dependencies point toward stable policy the domain must not import terminal json or filesystem apis. use a sealed result for expected input and storage outcomes reserve exceptions for violated programmer assumptions or truly exceptional lower level failures. the design is successful when the same core could serve an android screen domain tests pass. record decisions and commands in the readme. at completion compare the implementation to the acceptance examples and remove accidental complexity. a capstone is not judged by the status inspection focused staging diffs commits and history. inspect title trace one vertical slice language kotlin code jvminline value class expenseid val value string ndata class money val minor long init require minor 0 ndata class expense val id expenseid val category string val amount money nclass expensebook n private val values mutablelistof expense n fun add expense expense require values.none it.id expense.id values + expense n fun total long values.sumof it.amount.minor n walkthrough value types protect identifier and money meaning. expensebook owns the duplicate id invariant than durable application state. the system starts it when a component is needed and may kill it after the app moves to the background to reclaim memory. no callback is guaranteed at process
